replace.gjermundbu_helmet: The Gjermundbu helmet: a rounded plain dull-grey iron dome helmet with a goggle-shaped iron eye-and-nose guard across its front, and no horns.

add.promptBlock: A mail neck guard: a short curtain of small linked grey iron rings hanging from the back and sides of a plain iron helmet's rim.
An iron nose guard: a plain flat vertical iron bar hanging down from the front rim of a rounded iron helmet.
A Viking-age helmet fragment: a broken curved piece of rusty brown iron about the size of a hand, with jagged edges.
A horned-helmet tourist postcard: a small cream-colored card with a plain border and a simple flat drawing of a grey helmet with two curved horns.
A horned-helmet lunchbox: a small red metal lunchbox with a handle and a simple flat drawing of a helmet with two curved horns on its side.
A football team's horned-helmet logo: an invented round emblem of a dark blue helmet with two cream-colored curved horns, in flat colors.
